listing.name: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 2 — OpenKai2 (7v0biscuit)
listing.summary: The Windows runtime reaches level selection. Complete matches, performance and gameplay have not been confirmed. It uses a CPU renderer; stable 60 FPS during play is unverified. All host audio is disabled, including movies, menus and fights. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Budokai 2 ISO; it is required every time you play. The supported executable SHA-256 is 431568221bb744a6affc47dc91144b24892839d4d1ab8236bee1e03d83e6b898. This guide does not include a whole-disc hash or the exact serial number and revision; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the self-contained portable OpenKai2.exe launcher from OpenKai2-windows-x64.zip, or the OpenKai2-Setup.exe installer. The downloaded package does not require Python or Visual Studio and manages its own ISO cache. Generating and compiling source is a separate developer procedure.

warnings: The Windows runtime reaches level selection. Complete matches, performance and gameplay have not been confirmed. It uses a CPU renderer; stable 60 FPS during play is unverified. All host audio is disabled, including movies, menus and fights.
